item.content:encoded: (This event page is for masters students – undergraduate students can register here)Join the Tesla team for an interactive information session highlighting Tesla’s energy business, followed by live resume reviews and networking opportunities with hiring managers. We are recruiting for full-time engineering positions – primarily, students eligible to begin full-time work in December.Seniors and masters students in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, data science, cyber security, software design, computer programming, mechanical engineering. industrial engineering, automation engineering, network engineering, and information systems management majors are highly encouraged to attend.Tesla is able to sponsor for full-time roles.Please arrive 15 minutes before the event. Space is limited and on a first-come, first-served basis. Registering for this event does NOT guarantee entry.Registration in Handshake is required to attend, and SJSU Tower ID is required for event entry. **DISCLAIMER: Student information collected through registration or attendance may be shared with employers via Handshake.All Career Center in-person events are wheelchair accessible. Individuals requiring additional accommodations should contact the Career Center at 408-924-6031 or email careerhelp@sjsu.edu at least 48 hours before the start of the event.

item.content:encoded: Interested in a software engineering career?Join us for a panel featuring Veeva Systems software engineers and fellow SJSU alumni as they share insights from their first year in tech—what it’s really like to work as a full-stack, DevOps, or performance engineer, the impact they’ve made, and advice for navigating the job search as a new grad. After the discussion, stay to network with Veeva’s engineering and university recruiting teams to learn more about open opportunities and connect one-on-one.Current Internship and New Graduate Opportunities Include:Intern Software Engineer – Summer 2027Associate Software Engineer – 2027 Start DatesJuniors and seniors in software engineering, computer programming, data science, computer systems networking & telecommunications, computer science, information systems management, cyber security, data mining, user experience/social computing, computer engineering, computer engineering technologies & technicians and mathematics are highly encouraged to attend. Light refreshments will be provided!Learn more about career opportunities with Veeva Systems here. * Please note that Veeva Systems is NOT able to support OPT/CPT work authorization and/or provide visa sponsorship.Registration in Handshake is required to attend. Please arrive 15 minutes before the event. Space is limited and on a first-come, first-served basis. Registering for this event does NOT guarantee entry. Students must present their Tower ID for entry to the events.**DISCLAIMER: Student information collected through registration or attendance may be shared with employers via Handshake.All Career Center in-person events are wheelchair accessible. Individuals requiring additional accommodations should contact the Career Center at 408-924-6031 or email careerhelp@sjsu.edu at least 48 hours before the start of the event.

item.title: COMMUNITY EVENT: United States Postal Service Job Fair (San Jose)
item.dc:creator: Handshake #Event:2037440
item.description: The following event is promoted, but not operated by the SJSU Career Center. If you have questions about this event, please contact the event organizer directly.Event Details: Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 Time: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM Location: 1750 …
item.content:encoded:
The following event is promoted, but not operated by the SJSU Career Center. If you have questions about this event, please contact the event organizer directly.Event Details: 
Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 
Time: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
Location: 1750 Meridian Ave, San Jose, CA 95125
Cost: FREE (please register via EventBrite)
Do you like to work independently? Like to work outdoors in a physically vigorous job that’ll maintain your active fitness level? Providing a vital service to your community? Then the CITY CARRIER position may just be the job you’ve been waiting for. USPS jobs provide job security, great benefits, room to grow and advance within the organization, and the pride of providing a valuable service to your community. Start in your local office and you can quickly move into other positions and become the next generation of leaders. USPS is hiring throughout SAN JOSE and the SOUTH BAY. Come to the job fair for help submitting your online application. Computers will be available on site and USPS staff will be there to give you tips and guide you through the process.*This event is open to all community members.

item.title: College of Social Sciences Career Summit
item.dc:creator: Handshake #Event:2033932
item.description: Explore your future at the College of Social Sciences (CoSS) Career Summit, a dynamic event bringing together students from all departments within the College of Social Sciences. Discover the wide range of career paths available to social science majors and …
item.content:encoded:
Explore your future at the College of Social Sciences (CoSS) Career Summit, a dynamic event bringing together students from all departments within the College of Social Sciences. Discover the wide range of career paths available to social science majors and connect with professionals who’ve been where you are now.What’s Happening:

5th Annual Exploring Careers in Social Sciences Alumni Panel & Networking (3:00–5:00 PM): Discover how a degree in Social Sciences helped launch the careers of SJSU alumni.

Employer Resource Fair (5:00–6:30 PM): Connect with professionals from a variety of organizations, explore how your major applies in real-world settings, and expand your network in a relaxed environment.

Location: Student Union Ballroom A/B
Seating will be available on a first-come, first-served basis, with priority given to current SJSU students. Doors will open at 2:30 PM for check-in.For questions, please contact christine.bautista@sjsu.edu.All Career Center in-person events are wheelchair accessible. Individuals requiring additional accommodations should contact the Career Center at 408-924-6031 or email careerhelp@sjsu.edu at least 48 hours before the start of the event. Tower ID required for event entry.
